PLAN "Full 12-Week Programme Summary: Strength, Nutrition, Cardio, 1RM Testing, Sleep & Recovery"
TYPE summary
VISIBILITY public

SUMMARY
  TITLE: "12-Week General Strength Programme with Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition, Twice-Weekly Cardio, Final Week 1RM Test, Sleep & Recovery"
  FOCUS: "General strength with spinal load caution, progressive overload, anti-inflammatory nutrition, and structured recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks)
    DESCRIPTION: "Foundation building, technique, minimal spinal loading, 2–3 sessions/week + cardio as planned"
    WEEKS:
      WEEK 1:
        DAYS:
          - Monday 60m "Foundation Full-Body A": main sets 3x8..12, RPE 7, 90s rest
          - Wednesday 45m "Foundation Mobility & Pull Focus": 3x8..12 main; 90s rest
          - Friday 60m "Foundation Lower Body & Core": goblet_squat 3x10..15, 90s rest
        WARMUP_CARDIO: walking 5 min
        COOLDOWN: mobility as listed
      WEEK 2:
        DAYS:
          - Monday 60m "Foundation Full-Body A (Week 2)": 3x8..12
          - Wednesday 45m "Foundation Mobility & Pull Focus" (repeat)
          - Friday 60m "Foundation Lower Body & Core" (repeat)
      (Notes: progression via load/remain within RPE 7; keep spinal load light)

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks)
    DESCRIPTION: "Push intensity increases; maintain safety around spine"
    WEEKS:
      WEEK 5:
        DAYS:
          - Monday 60m "Progressive Load A (Phase 2 Push Intensity Start)": 4x6..8; rests 120s; includes ab_wheel
          - Wednesday 50m "Push & Pull Emphasis with Increased Intensity": 4x6..8; rests 120s
          - Friday 60m "Lower Body Robustness": deadlift 3x5..7; front_squat 3x6..8; leg_press 3x8..12
      WEEK 6-8:
        (Content mirrors Phase 2 structure with continued progression; details omit for brevity in summary)
  
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks)
    DESCRIPTION: "Strength building phase with higher load familiarity; maintain 2 cardio days"
    WEEKS:
      WEEK 9:
        DAYS:
          - Monday 60m "Strength Build A": squat 5x5; bench_press 5x5; barbell_row 5x5; overhead_press 4x6
          - Wednesday 55m "Auxiliary Upper Back & Core": deadlift 4x5; lat_pulldown 4x8; face_pull 3x12
          - Friday 60m "Lower Body Endurance & Stability": goblet_squat 4x10; hip_thrust 4x8..12; leg_curl 3x12
      WEEK 10-12:
        (Continuation of Phase 3 structure with planned deload and technique focus; details omitted for brevity)

  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks)
    DESCRIPTION: "Max strength ramp with taper and 1RM testing in final week"
    WEEKS:
      WEEK 13:
        DAYS:
          - Monday 60m "Max Strength Ramp": squat 3x3; bench_press 3x3; barbell_row 3x3; overhead_press 3x4
          - Wednesday 60m "Pull & Push Variants": incline_press 3x6..8; cable_row 3x8..10; pull_up 3x6..8; tricep_extension 3x10..12
          - Friday 60m "Legs & Core Stability": deadlift 3x5; front_squat 3x6; leg_extension 3x12; planks 3x60s
      WEEK 14-16:
        (Final week taper and 1RM testing integrated as described in final plan; details omitted in summary)

CARDIO
  FREQUENCY_PER_WEEK: 2
  SCHEDULE:
    - DAY Tuesday 30m "Cardio A": running
    - DAY Thursday 25m "Cardio B": cycling
  MODALITIES: running, cycling (permitted list)

NUTRITION
  DESCRIPTION: "Anti-inflammatory eating plan to support recovery, reduce systemic inflammation, and optimize training adaptations."
  TARGETS: "As specified in prior plan; emphasis on omega-3s, polyphenols, fiber, lean protein"
  DAILY_NUTRITION: "3 main meals + 1–2 snacks; protein target 1.6–2.2 g/kg; fats 25–35%; carbs moderate"
  FOOD_CHOICES: "Proteins, Carbs, Fats, Anti-inflammatory foods; limit processed items"
  TIMING: "Pre/post-workout protein + carbs as desired"
  HYDRATION: "30–35 ml/kg bodyweight; electrolytes on long/intense days"
  SUPPLEMENT_NOTES: "Consult clinician; optional omega-3; vitamin D as advised"
  FINAL_WEEK_TESTING: "1RM protocol included in Phase 4 with taper"
  
ABS & CORE SAFETY
  DESCRIPTION: "Safe core work aligned with back health; anti-rotation and anti-extension emphasis"
  RECOMMENDED_ABS: "plank, side_plank, dead_bug, bird_dog, standing_pallof_press, cable_front_and_side_brace, farmer_walk"
  CUES: "brace, neutral spine, proper breathing"
  PROGRESSION: "time/reps increase gradually; avoid spinal flexion loaded movements"

RECOVERY & SLEEP
  DESCRIPTION: "Sleep and recovery protocol integrated; 7.5–9 hours target; nap optional; mobility, breathing, and stress management"
  SLEEP_TARGET: duration 7.5..9 hours; consistency within 1 hour
  NAP_REGIMEN: 1..2 per week, 20–30 minutes
  ACTIVE_RECOVERY_MODALITIES: mobility flow, foam rolling, walking, breathing drills
  SLEEP_ENVIRONMENT: 18..20 C, dark, quiet, caffeine cut-off 14:00
  STRESS_MANAGEMENT: mindfulness 5 minutes; 2–3 leisure breaks
  LOAD_MANAGEMENT: auto-regulation 10–20% volume reduction if overreaching
  MONITORING: track sleep duration/quality, recovery, mood, energy; weekly review

FINAL_NOTES
  - All programming adheres to safety for prior L4-L5 herniation; avoid heavy spinal flexion/loading
  - 1RM testing planned in final phase with taper and technique checks
  - If symptoms arise, revert to prior week and consult clinician

ENDPLAN
